instructions: Pick the cheapest model tier that will do this coding-agent task well. Judge by how much reasoning the task needs, not by the topic words it mentions.

criteria.fast: Little or no reasoning: reply with fixed text, a greeting, fetch a page or compute a value and report it, run a named command and report the output, summarize a single page, fix a typo, rename or move a symbol or file in one or two named files.
criteria.standard: Routine engineering judgment: implement or fix a clearly scoped change, add a flag or test, review a diff, run a gate and fix what fails, land or verify a lane.
criteria.deep: Hard reasoning where a weaker model would likely be wrong: security or concurrency analysis, finding an unknown root cause such as a flaky test, architecture or design decisions, audits across many files, multi-step plans.
